title: DIR-3 KYC Annual Director Compliance: Deactivation Risks & Penalty Mitigation
summary: Navigating annual director verification before the September 30 ROC cutoff to avoid ₹5,000 late fees.
body:
Every individual holding an approved Director Identification Number (DIN) must complete e-KYC annually before September 30.

Review our full suite of [ROC and MCA filing services](/services) to keep your corporate filings active.

Non-compliance leads to immediate DIN deactivation and a ₹5,000 late fee. Click to [schedule a consultation](/schedule) with our corporate secretaries.
